title: 第20章 天涯阁
content_zh:
灵脉炼化后，魏乐府就将其安置在了他的府邸，与地脉融为一体。

    要是想要转移，收起来就行了，只不过难免会有损失。

    好在以后再融入地脉后也能温养回来，损失不大。

    在灵脉范围内，魏乐府感觉总算是好受了一些，天地间那种濒临死亡的死寂感消退了一些。

    似乎是因为灵气的周天流转和八方来朝形成的灵气聚拢和循环，隔绝了世界的这部分不适。

    对此，他感知了一下这微型灵脉的情况。

    以灵脉为中心，核心区域是半径十米，在这片区域里修炼的话，效率可谓是大幅度提升。

    甚至都不需要自己额外消耗灵力，就能够轻易维持老弟和黄巾力士的存在。

    连老弟在这里都是极为舒坦的。

    其次就是影响区，出了核心区后的范围大概是半径一百米。

    影响区无法享受到八方来朝的聚拢效果，不过受到周天流转的循环影响，其灵气浓度有所提升，只不过会随距离逐渐衰减。

    最外围的是一层单向隔离区，那范围就更大了，半径有五百米。

    这一块区域的灵气极为稀薄，甚至比其他地方还要低，是用来隔绝灵气外泄、保证灵气循环完整进行的。

    因为这是灵脉循环过程里形成的保护层，并且能通过对外产生的虹吸效果来聚拢灵气。

    得亏炼气士人数少，而普通人对于灵气基本没有交集，所以影响几乎没有。

    对此，魏乐府只能表示，世界真仁义啊。

    自己都只剩下一口气了，也要给他们提供成长环境。

    不过他估计，这第一次降临任务后，世界应该是又回了点血，不然不管是先天灵根还是灵脉，怎么看都不是一般东西。

    当然，这些东西可能在高武高魔世界里不算什么，但放在他所在的低魔世界里已经是大宝贝了。

    随着灵脉安置完毕，魏乐府发现他激活了个新的功能。

    名字叫做天涯阁，倒是挺会取名字的。

    随即点开一看，浮现出了一行文字，就是让他先取一个代号。

    魏乐府见此，不由得眯起了眼睛，怎么看着有点像是论坛？？？

    毕竟异界降临里不都有这么一出吗？

    思索再三后，他给自己的代号取为了孔雀东南飞。

    等下次有机会也可以把木兰诗安排出来，毕竟乐府双璧里的孔雀东南飞都有了。
content_en:
After the spiritual vein was refined, Wei Yuefu placed it in his mansion and integrated it with the earth vein.

    If you want to transfer it, just put it away, but there will inevitably be losses.

    Fortunately, it can be warmed and nourished after being integrated into the earth veins in the future, so the loss will not be big.

    Within the scope of his spiritual veins, Wei Yuefu finally felt a little better, and the sense of deathly silence between heaven and earth had subsided a little.

    It seems that the circulation of spiritual energy in the sky and the gathering and circulation of spiritual energy from all directions have isolated this part of the world from discomfort.

    In response, he sensed the situation of this miniature spiritual vein.

    With the spiritual vein as the center, the core area has a radius of ten meters. If you practice in this area, the efficiency can be said to be greatly improved.

    You can easily maintain the existence of your brother and the Yellow Turban Warriors without even having to expend extra spiritual energy.

    Even my brother feels very comfortable here.

    The second is the area of ​​influence. The area beyond the core area is about a hundred meters in radius.

    The affected area cannot enjoy the gathering effect of coming from all directions, but due to the cyclic influence of the circulation in the sky, its spiritual energy concentration has increased, but it will gradually decay with distance.

    The outermost is a one-way isolation zone, which is even larger, with a radius of 500 meters.

    The spiritual energy in this area is extremely thin, even lower than in other places. It is used to isolate the spiritual energy from leaking out and ensure the complete circulation of spiritual energy.

    Because this is a protective layer formed during the circulation of spiritual veins, and it can gather spiritual energy through the siphon effect produced externally.

    Unfortunately, there are only a small number of Qi refiners, and ordinary people have basically no contact with Reiki, so the impact is almost non-existent.

    In this regard, Wei Yuefu can only say that the world is truly benevolent and righteous.

    Even though I have only one breath left, I still need to provide them with an environment for growth.

    However, he estimated that after this first mission, the world should have regained some blood, otherwise, whether it is innate spiritual roots or spiritual veins, they would not be ordinary things.

    Of course, these things may not matter in the world of high martial arts and high magic, but in the world of low magic where he lives, they are already big treasures.

    With the placement of the spiritual veins completed, Wei Yuefu discovered that he had activated a new function.

    The name is Tianya Pavilion, and he is quite good at naming it.

    Then he clicked on it and a line of text appeared, asking him to choose a code name first.

    When Wei Yuefu saw this, he couldn't help but narrowed his eyes. Why did it look a bit like a forum? ? ?

    After all, isn’t this the case in Arrival from Another World?

    After much thought, he gave himself the code name Peacock Flying Southeast.

    I can also arrange the Mulan poem when I get the chance next time. After all, the peacocks in Yuefu Shuangbi have already flown southeast.
